title: Telemetria Veicular Simulada · InfluxDB local
description: Lê as séries gravadas por src/ingestor.py no bucket 'telemetria'. Todos os dados são gerados por src/simulator.py.

options.content: **Séries simuladas.** Geradas por `src/simulator.py` (avanço por distância, G lateral = v²/(R·g), térmica de primeira ordem) e gravadas via Line Protocol por `src/ingestor.py`. Não há veículo instrumentado.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "telemetria")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "dinamica" and r._field == "velocidade_kmh")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "velocidade")

from(bucket: "telemetria")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "motor" and r._field == "rpm")
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Lubrificação: pressão (bar) e temperatura do óleo (°C)

targets.query:
from(bucket: "telemetria")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "motor" and (r._field == "pressao_oleo_bar" or r._field == "temp_oleo_c"))
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "telemetria")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "motor" and r._field == "temp_agua_c")
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Comandos do piloto: acelerador (%) e freio (bar)

targets.query:
from(bucket: "telemetria")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "dinamica" and (r._field == "tps_percent" or r._field == "freio_bar"))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "telemetria")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "dinamica" and (r._field == "g_lat" or r._field == "g_long"))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "telemetria")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "gps")
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "latitude", "longitude", "velocidade_kmh"])
